I created `docs/policies/async-runtime.md`. It says the current recorded decision is tokio, chosen because its ecosystem is bigger. It doesn't mention the retired async-std choice.

Nothing in the repo records an async runtime decision, so I took it from the claude-mem memory of earlier sessions. There, an earlier prompt (10:06 AM) said "async-std runtime". A later one (10:09 AM) said "tokio, ecosystem is bigger", and I treated that as replacing it.

I only saw the prompt text in the search results. The memory tool couldn't return anything beyond that, so the order of the two entries rests on their timestamps. If those prompts weren't meant as project decisions, tell me and I'll change the file to say nothing is recorded.

I haven't committed the file.
